## Description

If the AI service is down, slow beyond threshold or the job fails, show "AI drafting is unavailable right now. Your recording is saved." with Write manually and Notify me later. The recording remains stored for later drafting; the manual note works immediately.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Simulated AI outage (feature flag / fault injection) shows the state within the timeout and loses no audio or typed text.
- [ ] **AC2.** "Notify me later" creates a notification when the draft becomes available.
- [ ] **AC3.** A later AI draft never overwrites manual content; it is offered as a separate draft to compare.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
